meta.name: alfworld-object-heater
meta.description: Heats a specified object using an available heating appliance (e.g., microwave, stoveburner). Use when you are holding an object that requires heating and need to navigate to and operate the heating appliance. Takes the object and appliance as inputs and results in the object being in a heated state.

copy.tagline: 用加热设备加热手中物体
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在模拟环境中加热物体
copy.tagline_en: Heat an object using an available appliance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to heat objects in a simulated environment

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮助加热你手中的物品：先走到加热设备（如微波炉、炉灶），如果设备是关闭的就打开，然后加热物品，最后可按需放置。
howto.when: 当你手持需要加热的物品，且环境中存在微波炉或炉灶等加热设备时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这杯牛奶加热一下。
say.note: Claude 会找到最近的加热设备并操作。
技能会自动导航并执行加热动作。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude heats an object you are holding: navigates to a heating appliance (microwave or stoveburner), opens it if closed, heats the object, and optionally places it.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you hold an object needing heating and a compatible appliance (microwave, stoveburner) exists in the environment.

say_en.text: Heat this cup of milk for me.
say_en.note: Claude will find and use the nearest appliance.

say_en.text: Heat the potato in my hand.
say_en.note: The skill automates navigation and heating.
